text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With less than a month remaining until the 
Prix Foy, the prep race for the grand 
stage, some major news came in one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
News arrives that Rigantona, hailed as the 
strongest Umamusume in Europe, will run in 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe―― A 
formidable titan who has conquered 
countless European GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her strength was prominent even in 
observed training, effortlessly 
overwhelming other Umamusume despite 
running at a restrained pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...However, this time was different from 
last year. Compared to previously, when 
she had no idea what she was doing, she 
now had the composure to devise 
counter-strategies."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Japan's Umamusume have built up more than 
enough strength. To face the legends, all 
they need now is confidence—
